objective: Evaluate the locked two-task routed decoder once on publisher validation against identical frozen Gemma.

frozen_constraints.sharding: task source index modulo task shard count

attribution.exclusion_reason: Row 0 base output was historically generated by four failed runtime-profile diagnostics before this final decoder lock.

decoder.attribution: frozen-base minimum mean candidate continuation NLL
decoder.narrative: use memory only for base=narration,memory=scene_description; otherwise use base
decoder.base_comparator: frozen-base output under the identical task-specific scorer

execution.gpu_0: attribution base, then narrative source indices congruent 0 modulo 4 base and memory
execution.gpu_1: scene source indices congruent 0 modulo 2 base and memory, then narrative source indices congruent 1 modulo 4
execution.gpu_2: scene source indices congruent 1 modulo 2 base and memory, then narrative source indices congruent 2 modulo 4
execution.gpu_3: narrative source indices congruent 3 modulo 4 base and memory

stopping_rule: Archive the one-shot publisher-validation outcome whether pass or fail; never tune from it and do not open publisher test or Hard32.
